name: oh-my-toolbelt
description: A toolbelt above the Claude Code prompt: clock, date, weather and a pomodoro on the left; your saved prompts, commands and one-press actions on the right; a panel for your prompts, notes, clipboard and settings.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. auto follows your system.

clockFormat.title: Clock format
clockFormat.description: 12 or 24 hours. auto follows your locale.

dateFormat.title: Date
dateFormat.description: The Date tool and its weekday: off (no Date tool), auto (your language's order), year first (2026/10/23), day first (23/10/2026) or month first (10/23/2026).

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: system uses your computer's time zone.

iconStyle.title: Icon style
iconStyle.description: How toolbelt buttons show their icon: icon and label, icon only, or label only (for terminals that draw emoji badly).

weatherPlace.title: Weather
weatherPlace.description: off by default. Picking a city sends that city's coordinates (not its name) to Open-Meteo for the forecast.

temperatureUnit.title: Temperature unit
temperatureUnit.description: auto follows the chosen city: Fahrenheit for US cities, Celsius elsewhere.

weatherRefreshMinutes.title: Weather refresh (minutes)
weatherRefreshMinutes.description: How often to refresh the weather.

pomodoroAutoBreak.title: Pomodoro auto break
pomodoroAutoBreak.description: Start the break when a focus round ends.

pomodoroSound.title: Pomodoro sound
pomodoroSound.description: Play a sound when a round ends (macOS only).

pomodoroSoundName.title: Pomodoro alert sound
pomodoroSoundName.description: The sound a round ends with when Pomodoro sound is on. Picking one in the Status tab plays it once.

exportDirectory.title: Export folder
exportDirectory.description: Where exports are saved. session is the project folder, where a conversation file could end up in git.

attachEnabled.title: Attach button
attachEnabled.description: The button that opens your system's file picker and puts the files in the prompt box (terminal only).

voiceMode.title: Voice mode
voiceMode.description: How the voice button records: tap (press Space to start and again to stop; three words or more are sent at once) or hold (hold Space while you speak; by default nothing is sent by itself). If you change the mode while voice is on (turned on with this button), the new mode applies at once.

pdfBrowser.title: PDF browser
pdfBrowser.description: off by default. A Chromium browser that prints the conversation to PDF (export as pdf); auto tries Chrome, Edge, Brave, then Chromium, as installed apps on macOS and Windows and by name on Linux.

curtainRestoreOnSubmit.title: Show transcript on submit
curtainRestoreOnSubmit.description: Turn the curtain off when you send a prompt.

hotkeysEnabled.title: Letter hotkeys
hotkeysEnabled.description: Letter hotkeys for the toolbelt buttons.

tocTab.title: Prompts tab
tocTab.description: List the prompts you sent in a panel tab. It reads this session's transcript file to list prompts sent before a restart, with tail (PowerShell on Windows) when the file is over 4 MiB. Turn this off if another contents mod does the same.

clipboardTab.title: Clipboard tab
clipboardTab.description: Collect what you copy by dragging over the screen in a panel tab, kept in memory until Claude Code closes. Works in the desktop app and where Claude Code draws the whole terminal screen (tui fullscreen).

paneOpenOnStart.title: Open panel at start
paneOpenOnStart.description: Open the panel when a session starts. Only a wide screen shows it.
